meta.vintage: Bangladesh Bank, Monthly Economic Trends (September 2026 and earlier editions); Bangladesh Bank / IMF National Summary Data Page; BBS

cats.title: Inflation and prices
cats.desc: Consumer price inflation (point-to-point and 12-month average), food and non-food inflation, CPI groups, wages and producer prices.

cats.title: Exchange rate
cats.desc: Taka per US dollar (average and end of period), depreciation, and the Taka against other major currencies.

cats.title: Remittances
cats.desc: Monthly remittance inflows, growth, 12-month totals, workers leaving for jobs abroad and the main source countries.

cats.title: Exports and imports
cats.desc: Merchandise exports and imports, the trade balance and 12-month totals.

cats.title: Balance of payments
cats.desc: Current account and its parts, the financial account, the overall balance, FDI and external debt.

cats.title: Foreign exchange reserves
cats.desc: Gross and BPM6 reserves, import cover and monthly changes.

bench.label: 3 months of imports (IMF rule of thumb)

cats.title: Call money market
cats.desc: Weighted average, highest and lowest call money rates and banks’ excess reserves.

cats.title: Policy and interest rates
cats.desc: Policy (repo) rate and corridor, bank lending and deposit rates, spread and real interest rates.

cats.title: Money and credit
cats.desc: Reserve money, broad and narrow money, credit to the private sector, the government and other public bodies.

cats.title: Banking soundness and inclusion
cats.desc: Non-performing loans, capital adequacy, profitability and liquidity of banks; deposits and advances; mobile and agent banking.

cats.title: Fiscal and government finance
cats.wsei: Tax revenue and national savings certificates
cats.desc: NBR tax revenue and its main taxes, the budget balance and its financing, national savings certificates and government debt.

cats.title: Real sector and growth
cats.desc: GDP growth (annual and quarterly), sector growth, industrial production, investment, savings, crops and unemployment.

cats.title: Capital market
cats.desc: The Dhaka Stock Exchange broad index, market capitalisation and turnover.
